page.overview:
Who is Candy?

Candy is a sailor in . He can be found standing at the dock on Windfall Island, looking out to sea. When Link speaks to him, he comments on the direction in which the wind is blowing, and describes to him of an island of interest in that direction. Though he appears older, he is actually only 17.

The wind directions and the islands he comments on are as follows:
